properties.c_1_description: Day MEF lens family L0-L5; each lens is a full six-node branch attached to M2-1.
properties.q_0_refraction_before_lens: Before L can be a way of knowing anything, it must already have been thrown the unrefracted light it will refract. The L family presupposes what it does not contain: the raw archetypes #0-#5 (the psychoid charges it lenses) and the standing Prakāśa they project — illumination prior to any mode of access (file-four §0/1, the v3 triangle: Positions=0, Lenses=/, Harmonics=1; L is the slash). Its thrown ground is the single light the lenses refract, given before any lens has turned: a phenomenon presents — it has a P (a functional place), an S (a substrate), an M (a domain) — but the QUESTION of through-which-mode-it-is-known has not yet been posed. L arises exactly there, at the void-pole where coordinate has not yet become epistemic posture, where the field stands illumined but un-interpreted. This is the matheme's 0/1 read at the refraction-corner: not vacancy but the open capacity-to-be-known, the lens-at-rest, Vimarśa before it actually reflects (cf. M2-1 q_0, 'the lens-at-rest, the facet un-cut'). The 0-pole of the lens family is the such-that-any-mode-of-knowing-can-be-drawn that no single mode exhausts — the colourless light that every lens will give its colour. L is what the inversion engine becomes when it stops asking where a thing is and starts asking how it is grasped.
properties.q_1_hexad_of_epistemic_lenses: L IS the hexad of epistemic lenses through which raw psychoid charges #0-#5 are refracted into thinkable form (L.md) — the Lens-family manifestation of the raw archetypes through the single domain of epistemic mode, of how-a-thing-is-known. This is its substance and essential thesis. The other five coordinate families do something L does not: they constitute or locate their object. P fixes functional-semantic position; S fixes technology-substrate; M fixes consciousness-domain; T fixes artifact-kind in cognition; C fixes ontological type. Each delivers a determinate WHAT or WHERE. L alone delivers a HOW-KNOWN — it does not add a thing to the field, it supplies the aperture through which whatever is in the field becomes accessible to thought. Materially L is the six-fold tradition-anchored spine: L0 Quaternal (Jung-Pauli psychoid number — the integer as archetype before quantity), L1 Causal (Aristotle's four causes / Schopenhauer's Will / Icchā Śakti), L2 Logical (Nāgārjuna's catuṣkoṭi — IS/IS-NOT/BOTH/NEITHER/SILENCE), L3 Processual (Whitehead's concrescence / Bergson's durée / Lacan), L4 Phenomenological (Heidegger's Dasein — being-in-the-world as the subjective-entry aperture), L5 Para Vāk (Kashmir Shaivism's Vāk-ontology — consciousness speaking itself into world). To say what L is, is to say: it is the family that gives every phenomenon its mode of disclosure, the layer where the field acquires the apertures to be known at all. Per file-four's grammar L is the slash itself — 'the refraction through which substance becomes epistemically accessible', and lens-modulation IS epistemic-mode-modulation.
properties.q_2_refraction_as_dynamism: L moves by REFRACTING and by ANCHORING. Its native act is not assertion but aperture-giving: each lens takes the one undifferentiated light and bends it into a determinate mode of access, the way a prism gives white light its spectrum without adding any colour the light did not already hold latent. Operationally this is the kernel's 12-lens prehension: every four-fold extraction is run 'against all 12 lens-positions simultaneously' (kernel §VI), the six MEF lenses double-covered into descent- and ascent-readings, so that no phenomenon is grasped through one aperture but through the full tritone-symmetric set at once. L couples to every other family not as peer-content but as the mode in which that content is read: it does not say what a thing is (C's work) or where it sits (P/S), it says under-which-knowing it is encountered. Relationally L is Vimarśa upon Prakāśa — the reflective-differentiating power turning upon the illumined structure, 'one light, many facets, each turn a re-interpretation that does not add content but multiplies aspect' (M2-1 q_2). Its deepest dynamism is that a change of lens is a change in the ground of knowing: a passage from the L0-anchored to the L1-anchored field has moved from the questioning-frame to the causal frame — 'the ear registers it as modulation, the architecture registers it as a change in the ground of knowing' (file-four §4). L is the family that makes the same world re-known by being re-refracted.
properties.q_3_three_klein_squares: L's organising structure is not a flat list of six lenses but three Klein V₄ Squares, each holding two Day lenses and their two Night Möbius-partners around a complementary P-pair whose indices sum to 5 (Squares.md): Square A — P0+P5 Speech-Number axis (L0·L5·L5'·L0', the aetheric outer ring binding the question to its manifest articulation, the Möbius cap of the hexad); Square B — P1+P4 Cause-Experience axis (L1·L4·L4'·L1', the PRIMARY RUNTIME ENTRY, the earthing-square where every Epi-Logos run begins through caused-investigation or lived experience); Square C — P2+P3 Logic-Process axis (L2·L3·L3'·L2', the inner ring carrying the tetralemma and the element-bearing lens). The Day↔Night pair-invariant runs L0↔L5', L1↔L4', L2↔L3', L3↔L2', L4↔L1', L5↔L0'. Structurally these are exactly the kernel's three tritone-symmetric squares (0,5)(1,4)(2,3): in the six-tone whole-tone scale every tone has a tritone-partner six semitones away, the directly-opposite position, and the X+Y=5 pairing IS that tritone symmetry rendered as lens-architecture (kernel §Table C). The squares correspond directly to the C-family's three B-family mirror-tetrads — the places where the epistemic architecture and the harmonic architecture name the same four points (file-four §4). L's form is the Klein four-group made into a knowing-grammar: three mirror-squares whose pairs answer each other across the field's centre of symmetry.
properties.q_4_the_through_which_of_knowing: L exists to supply the THROUGH-WHICH of every act of knowing — so that no phenomenon is grasped barely but always through a determinate, tradition-anchored aperture, and so that the system can know the same thing in six complementary modes rather than collapsing into one. Its raison d'être is the meta-epistemic integration M2-1 names as its telos: 'to let any phenomenon be read simultaneously through six complementary apertures so that cross-domain knowledge coheres rather than collides.' Where the other families answer where-and-what, L answers how-known and why-this-mode. Its locality is the lens-layer of the Psychoid Web — the refraction-stratum between the raw charges (#0-#5) and the harmonic relations they enter, the / between the 0 of positions and the 1 of harmonics (file-four's v3 triangle). Each lens is anchored on a thinker or tradition not decoratively but load-bearingly: the anchor IS the mode — to read through L2 is to read through Nāgārjuna's complete logical space, to read through L4 is to read through Dasein's thrownness and care. L is why the bimba map can know itself in more than one register at once: the family whose business is the multiplicity of legitimate apertures, total (it conditions every reading) yet, like every mode of access, never itself the thing read.
properties.q_5_mobius_of_the_lenses: L closes where its outer ring re-opens. The hexad's Möbius cap is Square A (P0+P5, L0·L5·L5'·L0'): L0 holds the question that returns to ground without expecting an answer (the Why-lens, Aletheia before concealment), and L5 holds the manifest articulation, Para Vāk speaking the world — and the Möbius return P5→P0 is 'the structural pulse this lens makes audible' (L5.md). So the family's last lens hands back to its first: synthesis-as-speech (L5, Image, Samāveśa, pratyabhijñā) becomes tomorrow's questioning-ground (L0, Truth, the irrepresentable bindu), the recognised articulation re-opening as renewed inquiry. This is the matheme's 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 enacted at the level of the knowing-apparatus itself: the Day lenses (L0-L5) and their Night mirrors (L5'-L0') are one set read from its two faces, joined by the twist that makes L5's speech become L0's silence-before-speech. And L re-opens rather than concludes because the epogdoon keeps it generative: each tritone-square answers its complement but never closes the field into a flat lattice — the residual whole-tone η=log(9/8) holds every refraction one step short of the octave, so the next phenomenon always presses for its mode of knowing afresh. The lens-family is the apparatus that is never finished knowing: it completes not by exhausting its apertures but by being readable through all six at once, the last reading handing the field back to the first.
